question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice.**

The manager told the team that their recent performance had been impressive, but that they had to now focus on the upcoming project which was a much bigger challenge, and he was confident that they would succeed in it.

options.text: "Your recent performance was impressive, but you must now focus on the upcoming project which is a much bigger challenge, and I am confident that you will succeed in it," the manager said to the team.

"Your recent performance has been impressive, but you have to now focus on the upcoming project which is a much bigger challenge, and I am confident that you will succeed in it," the manager said to the team.

"Your recent performance has been impressive, but you must now focus on the upcoming project which is a much bigger challenge, and I am confident that you will succeed in it," the manager said to the team.

"Their recent performance was impressive, but they had to now focus on the upcoming project which was a much bigger challenge, and he was confident that they would succeed in it," the manager said to the team.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. "Your recent performance has been impressive, but you must now focus on the upcoming project which is a much bigger challenge, and I am confident that you will succeed in it," .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The question asks us to select the option that expresses the given sentence in **direct voice**.
 
• The original sentence is in **indirect voice**, as it uses phrases like "the manager told the team that."
 
• The direct voice version of this sentence should use quotation marks and the speaker's exact words.
 
• Option 3 is correct because it accurately conveys the manager's statement in direct voice while maintaining proper grammar and tense consistency.
 
• The use of "has been impressive" in Option 3 reflects the correct tense, making it appropriate for the situation described.

Correct sentence: *"Your recent performance has been impressive, but you must now focus on the upcoming project which is a much bigger challenge, and I am confident that you will succeed in it," the manager said to the team.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Direct Voice:**
 
 
• The speaker's exact words are quoted using quotation marks.
 
• Example: He said, "I will complete the project by tomorrow."
 
 
 
• **Indirect Voice:**
 
 
• The speaker's statement is paraphrased without quotation marks.
 
• Example: He said that he would complete the project by tomorrow.
